title: Rebase project manifest
description: Declares which runtime major a project targets and which apps this repository contributes to it. Topology only — collections, security rules, hooks and functions stay in TypeScript.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor completion.

rebase.description: Runtime contract major this project targets, as a semver range (e.g. "^1"). The platform upgrades patches and minors underneath a project; it never crosses a major. Named "rebase" so that "runtime" means exactly one thing — who owns the backend process.

apps.description: Apps this repository contributes, keyed by name. The key is the app's identity within the project.

propertyNames.description: Lowercase alphanumeric with dashes — the name appears in URLs.

telemetry.description: Repository-wide opt-out from anonymous CLI usage sharing. Only `false` does anything: it suppresses sharing for everyone who clones this repository, overriding each developer's own opt-in. `true` is deliberately ignored — this file is committed, so a `true` here would answer a privacy question on behalf of every colleague who later clones the repo. Individuals opt in with `rebase telemetry enable`.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the directory holding rebase.json.

backendApp.description: The collections, hooks and functions that define the project's API. Exactly one per project.

runtime.description: Who owns the process. "managed": the platform runtime image boots this project's bundle. "custom": this repository builds its own image and entrypoint. Independent of where it runs — both run on Rebase Cloud and both self-host.

config.description: Directory of the config package. Default "config". When it exists, collections come from code; when it does not, they are introspected from the live database at boot.

crons.description: Directory of cron job definitions. Default "backend/crons".

usersCollection.description: Module path (relative to config) exporting the auth users collection. Default "collections/users".

dockerfile.description: Custom runtime only. Dockerfile path. Default "Dockerfile".

context.description: Custom runtime only. Build context. Default ".".

port.description: Custom runtime only. Port the container listens on. Default 8080.

staticApp.description: A pre-built client bundle — an SPA or static site — served at its declared path. The admin panel is one of these.

build.description: Command producing `output`. Run from the repository root, with REBASE_APP_BASE set from `path`.

path.description: Public base path this app is served under, e.g. "/admin". A build-time input as well as a serving concern: the app must be built for this path (Vite's `base`), or every asset 404s. Must be unique across the project's static apps, and must not be a path the backend owns (/api, /health, /healthz, /livez, /readyz, /metrics) — mounting is longest-path-first, so an app declared there would answer the API's requests with its own index.html.

spa.description: Serve index.html for unmatched paths under `path` (client-side routing).
